entities.name: Hylda of the Icy Crown
entities.description: A powerful ice-wielding witch of Eldraine, aloof sister of Agatha and Eriette.

entities.name: Talion
entities.description: Faerie who cast the Wicked Slumber with the sisters and gave Hylda the Icy Crown.

entities.name: Wicked Slumber
entities.description: Curse cast to end the New Phyrexian Invasion.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: Invasion ended by the Wicked Slumber.

entities.name: Icy Crown
entities.description: Crown that greatly enhances Hylda's powers.

entities.name: Winter's Home
entities.description: Hylda's ice castle in Dunbarrow above Loch Larent.

entities.name: Loch Larent
entities.description: Loch frozen over by Hylda's ice, trapping the merfolk of Sharae.

entities.name: Kellan
entities.description: Came searching for the icy crown, discovered his ability to manifest ethereal light weapons.

entities.name: Ruby
entities.description: Carried Kellan nearly to the castle gates, convincing Hylda to relent.

events.summary: Hylda and her sisters help Talion cast the Wicked Slumber to end the invasion; Talion gives her the Icy Crown.
events.quote: Hylda and her sisters Agatha and Eriette helped the faerie Talion cast the Wicked Slumber to end the New Phyrexian Invasion

events.summary: After the invasion Hylda builds Winter's Home, and her ice freezes Loch Larent, trapping the merfolk of Sharae.
events.quote: froze over the Loch, trapping the merfolk of Sharae beneath the ice

events.summary: Kellan battles Hylda's ice elementals, discovers his ability to manifest light weapons, and strikes down the last elemental before collapsing.
events.quote: he discovered his ability to manifest weapons made from ethereal light

events.summary: Ruby's selflessness convinces Hylda to relent and relinquish her crown, and Hylda kisses Kellan's forehead and protects them from the cold.
events.quote: Her act of selflessness convinced Hylda to relent and relinquish her crown.

relations.quote: She is the sister of Agatha , Eriette
She is the sister of Agatha , Eriette

relations.note: Gave her the Icy Crown in exchange for help.
relations.quote: In exchange, Talion gave her the Icy Crown
Kellan and Ruby came to the frozen kingdom searching for the icy crown
